candidate_relations.reason: The record supports systemic sclerosis sine scleroderma through Raynaud phenomenon, anti-centromere positivity, inflammatory polyarthritis, and pulmonary hypertension without skin thickening. Labeling the pulmonary hypertension idiopathic also omits and conflicts with the likely systemic-sclerosis association.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pulmonary arterial hypertension is a cardiopulmonary manifestation/complication, not the underlying systemic sclerosis sine scleroderma diagnosis.
